simple.meaning: כָּתָב (kâthâb) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “something written , i.e. a writing , record or book.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 16 times across 1 Chronicles, 2 Chronicles, Ezra, Nehemiah, Esther, and 2 more, beginning at 1 Chronicles 28:19. Its contexts include family, family line, kingship, priesthood, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כָּתָב (H3791).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: כָּתָב (kâthâb) / H3791 is traced through 1 Chronicles 28:19, 2 Chronicles 2:10, 2 Chronicles 35:4, Ezra 2:62 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: something written , i.e. a writing , record or book
definitions.full: H3791. kethab כְּתָב noun masculine Ezra 4:7 writing (late Aramaic; Biblical Aramaic כְּתָב Syriac ); — ׳כ absolute 1Chr 28:19 4 t.; construct Ezek 13:9 4 t.; suffix כְּתָבָהּ Est 1:22 2 t.; כְּתָבָם Ezra 2:62 3 t.; — writing: 1 register, enrolement , Ezek 13:9 ; Ezra 2:62 = Neh 7:64 . 2 = mode of writing, character, letter , ׳וּכ אֲרָמִית כָּתוּב הִנִּשְׁתְּוָן Ezra 4:7 and the writing of the letter was written in Aramaic (characters; so probably, see BeRy Ryle, compare Late Hebrew Hoffm ZAW i.(1881), 334 ff. ); compare Est 1:22 ; 3:12 ; 8:9 (twice in verse). 3 = letter , 2Chr 2:10 ; Est 9:27 . 4 of a royal enactment, edict 2Chr 35:4 (|| מִכְתָּב ), Est 3:14 ; 8:8 , 13 ; more fully כְּתָבהַֿדָּת 4:8 . 5 of a writing with divine authority 1Chr 28:19 ; ׳כ אֱמֶת Dan 10:21 , i.e. a book of truth.
